title: Endpoint latency slices: streaming vs batch dashboard with trace anchors
creator: Anjali Patel
description: Build a new latency surface that slices endpoint-level metrics by serving mode (streaming vs non-streaming / batched), model family, and client route. Deliverable is a Grafana dashboard + Cortex/Prometheus queries and dashboard docs that show p50/p95/p99 with per-mode breakdowns and jump-to-trace anchors that link to our tracing system. Work includes: adding lightweight tracing hooks in the serving runtime to tag span attributes for 'serve.mode' and 'route.owner', enriching metrics with a 'serve_mode' label where possible, and creating log/metric pipeline transforms so dashboards are accurate for both streaming partial responses and final sync responses.
acceptance_criteria: Grafana dashboard panels for endpoints that display p50, p95, p99 with separate series for streaming and non-streaming
Each panel has a 'Jump to trace' link that opens the tracing UI filtered to the representative slow samples for the selected percentile
Prometheus/Cortex queries are efficient (no high-cardinality explosion) and documented in the dashboard JSON
Serving runtime emits 'serve.mode' and 'route' attributes in spans and metrics for >=95% of requests after rollout
Automated smoke test that compares synthetic streaming vs sync payloads to ensure metrics separation is correct
Dashboard reviewed and approved by Observability PM and Runtime lead (signoffs in comments)
implementation_notes: Instrument runtime: add span attribute 'serve.mode' with values 'stream'|'sync' in ServeRequest handler path
Metrics: introduce 'serve_mode' label for request_latency_histogram and request_duration_summary, keep cardinality low by using normalized route keys
Tracing: add a lightweight sampling override for traces that contribute to p99 so jump-to-trace shows representative examples
Pipeline: create a transform in telemetry-pipeline to map log-level streaming partial events to 'stream' serve_mode for metrics aggregation
Queries: use histogram_quantile with a 10-second sliding window for streaming percentiles to reflect live behavior; provide alternative query for 1-minute aggregation
Dashboards: panels grouped by 'endpoint family' (normalized route), with toggles for model family and serve mode filter
Runbook: document interpretation guidance (e.g., streaming p95 includes partial-chunk time vs sync final-write time differences)
